/projects/momentum.title: Momentum — Offline-First Productivity App | Venkatesh Prabhatha Kana
/projects/momentum.description: Momentum is an offline-first personal productivity app for planning tasks, tracking time and consistency, scheduling work, and receiving local notifications.
/projects/momentum.heading: Momentum
/projects/momentum.intro: An offline-first personal productivity application for task planning, time tracking, scheduling, consistency tracking, and local notifications.

sections.heading: Purpose
paragraphs: Momentum is designed to help people decide what to do next and maintain a practical routine. It supports daily and occasional tasks, custom sections, calendar planning, time-based performance tracking, streaks, recovery days, and next-action guidance.
Core productivity data is stored locally with IndexedDB, so the application can be used without an account, backend, or internet connection. Local notifications support reminders.
